development_only_fixed_hint_override.text: The prior failed contract is your prediction, not a caller requirement. Re-plan the unfinished requested operations from the unchanged caller request. A revision may use one objective combining remaining operations when its instruction explicitly names them all and their outcome is justified. Keep the original final predicates and check them only after actual input. Do not require an invented intermediate caption again or restart established selections. Missing your own predicted text alone is not a missing or conflicting caller parameter and does not justify needs_clarification. The action layer will inspect visible controls and attempt the remaining operations. Use needs_clarification only for an actual caller conflict, missing required parameter, or no justified actionable workflow, with no goals. Never force ready, drop caller operations or claim that the old failed objective succeeded.
